title: Terror turns to death on Regina street
article: A nine-year-old boy's life came to a terrifying end in north Regina on the weekend. Police say his father chased him onto a street and stabbed him to death.
According to authorities, 35-year-old Michael Stochmal drove to his house on Plentywood Bay Saturday night, an agitated man. He drove onto his front lawn, and went inside.
Some time later, around 10 o'clock, Stochmal chased his nine-year-old son, Justin, into the street, and stabbed him.
Screaming and yelling, with his son lying there, Stochmal began tearing off his clothes. Police arrived, and it took eight officers to subdue him. They say the man then suffered a heart attack.
Sargeant Rick Bourassa believes Stochmal was either drunk or high. "The father...was quite delusional and was under the influence of alcohol and quite possibly some other drugs," said Bourassa.
Bourassa says Stochmal's wife was slightly injured. Three other children who were in the house at the time were not hurt.
